_comment: The shared contract between the colour grammar's two copies: frontend/renderer/src/components/features/wholesale/shared.ts (colorQtyProblem/parseColorQty, instant feedback while typing) and backend/app/services/wholesale/colors.py (color_qty_problem/parse_color_qty, the authoritative check on every write). Both must agree on every case here — if one changes, update this file and check the other copy still passes.

problems.problem: There is an empty piece — check the commas.
"10" has no color in front of it.
"10s" is not a color, a count and a unit, like black10s.
"black10" needs a unit — s for sets, p for pairs, d for dozens.
"black10x" ends in "x" — use s for sets, p for pairs, d for dozens.
"black-10s" is not a color, a count and a unit, like black10s.
